title: Software Engineer
description: Developed a Java prototype to determine whether Harris' service-based architecture, originally created for GOES-R, could support radar-data processing. The work redirected the architecture toward the next generation of GOES-R processing and ultimately contributed to the WxConnect program.
highlights: Integrated the Advanced Radar Processing system with Harris' service-based architecture platform to evaluate whether it could support radar-data processing workflows.
Helped pivot the research toward improving the architecture for next-generation GOES-R data processing.
Contributed prototype work that evolved into the WxConnect program.
